newsitem.title: USA: Riddell Sports sells $115 mln 144A notes.
newsitem.headline: Riddell Sports sells $115 mln 144A notes.

text.p: The following debt issue from Riddell Sports Inc was priced in the 144A private placement market on Friday via NationsBanc Capital Markets Inc, according to a syndicate official.
The offering was increased to $115 million from an original size of $100 million, the source added.
Riddell is a manufacturer and reconditioner of football protective equipment and is a supplier of uniforms and accessories for sale to the school spirit industry.
